title: Waves App - Launch & Regional Growth
description:
In June 2021, Waves App partnered with Astroshot to launch and grow a new watercraft booking platform for Kuwait and the GCC. The product was not a simple entertainment page. Waves was building a marketplace connecting renters with yacht owners, trips, activities, water taxi, marine services, waterfront F&B, and future lifestyle categories.

The challenge
Waves needed more than awareness. The brand had to educate renters, earn trust from yacht owners, explain the booking experience, drive app downloads, support partner collaborations, and present a growth story strong enough for regional expansion and investor conversations.

From launch campaign to growth engine
Astroshot built the communication layer around the app through launch strategy, monthly social media management, campaign planning, motion graphics, video production, photography, animation, contests, and brand collaboration assets.

The work helped Waves explain the product clearly while keeping the brand visible every month across entertainment, booking, travel, and lifestyle content.

A stronger business story
Waves' September 2023 second-round fundraising deck showed the scale behind the platform: 200K+ app downloads, 13K trips transacted, 8x year-on-year growth, 3 countries present, 6+ revenue streams, an average basket size of $600, and a $1.6M May 2023 revenue run rate.

Regional expansion
The platform was active across Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar, with Dubai and additional Saudi cities on the expansion roadmap. Astroshot's content and campaign system supported Waves as it moved from local app launch into a regional watercraft and entertainment platform.

The result
Waves built 60K+ followers, reached millions across social channels, supported 200K+ app downloads, reached a #2 Entertainment App position, and developed a marketing foundation strong enough to support long-term growth and investor-facing storytelling.

App launch. Marketplace education. Regional expansion. Investor-ready growth story.
